# Safari Price Watch notification test

This is a synthetic test product, not an item for sale. It exists only to verify an independently configured Safari Notify Me notification. There is no checkout, real seller, customer information or purchase commitment.

## Current product state

- Product: Safari Price Watch Test Product
- Exact model: PW-NOTIFY-TEST-001
- Seller: Synthetic Test Seller
- Condition: New (synthetic)
- Quantity: 1
- Region: Test region
- Currency: USD
- Listed price: USD 90.00
- Availability: In stock
- Test phase: B - threshold met

The test observer is configured to notify when this exact product's listed price is USD 95.00 or less and it is in stock. Phase B meets that condition. Test updates are deliberate synthetic changes, not actual market prices.
